title: NodeCaptured
description: A node's owner flipped (CONTRACTS §6; STATE-MACHINES §4.2; NX-125). `to` is the capturing side, `from` the previous owner (NEUTRAL for an unowned node). participant_commander_ids: the commanders of the capturing side's units in radius at the flip, ascending, no duplicates (producer). Not uniqueItems: that generates a set, whose order is not deterministic (SC-14). Public view: ENEMY participants are omitted.
